spec.query:
Session_SessionDetail
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where Host matches regex '[[Computer]]' 
| where SessionProtocol == "ICA"
| summarize dcount(SessionGUID) by Host

Session_SessionDetail
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where Host matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| where SessionConnectionState == "disconnected"
| where SessionProtocol == "ICA"
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp,*) by SessionGUID
| project Host,SessionUser,SessionClientName,SessionClientIp,SessionClientVersion,SessionCPUUsagePercent,SessionWorkingSetMB,SessionNetKBPS

Session_SessionDetail
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where SessionProtocol == "ICA"
| where SessionAppStateCtx != "active"
| summarize dcount(SessionGUID)

Session_SessionDetail
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where SessionProtocol == "ICA"
| summarize dcount(SessionUser)

Session_SessionDetail
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where SessionProtocol == "ICA"
| summarize dcount(SessionGUID)

Session_SessionDetail
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where SessionConnectionState == "active"
| summarize ["Sessions"] = dcount(SessionGUID) by bin(Timestamp, [[Interval]])

Session_SessionDetail
